reason: My Intercom/Tidio setup is fine and nothing is on fire. I'd maybe test the free plan, but I wouldn't start paying within a month for a tool I can't find reviews of on G2 or Capterra.
objection: Is it worth the risk of a bot adding to cart or filling forms on my live store, and what happens to costs and customer data if conversations explode? The GDPR agreement and hard caps help, but I have no independent proof it lifts sales.
would_change_my_mind: A free-plan A/B test on my own store showing a measurable lift in sales, plus G2/Capterra reviews from other store owners.
